alex: FYI — were running a short KV-cache prefill + controlled traffic-shaping experiment tomorrow 2026-06-04 02:00 UTC (45m). Objective: verify warm cache hit improvements and quantify p99 behavior before the wider quantized model rollout. Internal SLO tweak only: generation p99 relaxed from 120ms -> 220ms for affected routes during the window.

mina: scope? which routes/tenants?

alex: scope = /v1/generate (all tiers) but only ~10% steered to canary pools in region-usw1 and region-eu1. No reserved/dedicated customer capacity will be modified. Opt-in customers and internal test traffic only.

jamal: oncall here, acked. Ill be watching and ready to roll back.

olivia: any external comms or legal sign-off needed?

alex: no external comms. Compliance and PMs for opt-ins have been informed. If we see elevation we abort and restore normal routing.

rohit: post the monitoring queries + runbook pls.

alex: pasted short runbook and the PromQL queries well watch. Escalation: if p99 > 300ms AND error_rate > 0.5% for 3m -> rollback.

alex: ```Runbook short:
1) Dash: https://dash.board/redwood/kvcache-prefill (watch route + canary pool)
2) If p99(gen) > 300ms && err_rate > 0.5% -> `rdctl routing set /v1/generate default`
3) If GPU mem > 85% -> `feature-flag set kvcache_prefill=false`
4) Tag postmortem: incident:type=experiment
```

alex: PromQL examples:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_ms_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
100 * rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",status!~"2.."}[3m])
```

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: kvcache prefill experiment starts in 10m (2755560000 -> 2755562700). :bell:

mina: will prefill create egress/disk bursts? ping infra to expect transient IO.

alex: read-heavy on model kv-store + memcopies to GPU. Infra aware; will throttle if we see disk/network pressure.

jamal: I'm setting a quiet window for noisy non-prod jobs during the experiment.

rohit: adding synthetic stabilizer load to the canary pool. earlier run: `./stressgen --route /v1/generate --qps 50 --seq 1024 --duration 1800s`

olivia: product will monitor opt-in customer signals and jump in on anomalies.

deploy-bot: deploying: kvcache-prefill-v2 -> canary-pool (id d-99234). CI logs: https://ci/redwood/d-99234

jamal: noted deploy, will watch health checks and have rollback ready.

alex: TL;DR — 45m experiment, internal p99 SLO relaxation for canary /v1/generate, monitoring and runbook posted, oncall + infra watching. Ping me or @jamal with issues. :rocket:
